command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; echo source_head=$(git rev-parse origin/main); SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test "$SERIAL" = RFCT70L7E8J; echo serial=$SERIAL; PID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); echo pid=$PID; echo '--- top-activity ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | head -n 8 || true; echo '--- scanner-service ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -E 'ScannerService|ServiceRecord' | head -n 20 || true; if [ -n "$PID" ]; then echo '--- cpu-samples ---'; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do adb -s "$SERIAL" shell top -b -n 1 -p "$PID" | tail -n 3 | head -n 1 || true; sleep 1; done; echo '--- meminfo ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys meminfo io.blueeye | head -n 120 || true; echo '--- gfx-summary ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys gfxinfo io.blueeye | head -n 120 || true; echo '--- recent-gc ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief -t 2500 | grep -E -i 'io.blueeye|GC freed|WaitForGcToComplete|Alloc concurrent copying|Background concurrent copying|OutOfMemory' | tail -n 160 || true; fi; echo PHASE3_SETTINGS_PERF_SNAPSHOT_DONE
